1.text: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by tha will of God, N Timothy our brother, 2 tha church of God which is at Corinth, wit all tha saints which r in all Achaia:
Grace be 2 u N peace from God our Father, N from tha Lord Jesus Christ.
Blessed be God, even tha Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, tha Father of mercies, N tha God of all comfort;
Who comforteth us in all our tribulation, dat we may be able 2 comfort ’em which r in any trouble, by tha comfort wherewith we ourselves r comforted of God.
4 as tha sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.

N whether we be afflicted, it is 4 ur consolation N salvation, which is effectual in tha endurin of tha same sufferings which we also suffer: or whether we be comforted, it is 4 ur consolation N salvation.
N our hope of u is stedfast, knowin, dat as y’all r partakers of tha sufferings, so shall y’all be also of tha consolation.
4 we would not, brothers, have u ignorant of our trouble which came 2 us in Asia, dat we were pressed out of measure, above strength, insomuch dat we despaired even of life:
But we had tha sentence of death in ourselves, dat we should not trust in ourselves, but in God which raises tha dead:
Who delivered us from so great a death, N does deliver: in whom we trust dat he will yet deliver us;
y’all also helping together by prayer 4 us, dat 4 tha gift bestowed upon us by tha means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf.

4 our rejoicin is dis, tha testimony of our conscience, dat in simplicity N godly sincerity, not wit fleshly wisdom, but by tha grace of God, we have had our conversation in tha world, N more abundantly 2 u-ward.
4 we write none other things 2 u, than what y’all read or acknowledge; N I trust y’all shall acknowledge even 2 tha end;
As also y’all have acknowledged us in part, dat we r ur rejoicin, even as y’all also r ours in tha day of tha Lord Jesus.
N in dis confidence I was minded 2 come 2 u before, dat y’all might have a second benefit;
N 2 pass by u in2 Macedonia, N 2 come again out of Macedonia 2 u, N of u 2 be brought on my way toward Judaea.
When I therefore was like dis minded, did I use lightness? or tha things dat I purpose, do I purpose according 2 tha flesh, dat wit me there should be yeah yeah, N no no?
But as God is true, our word toward u was not yeah N no.
4 tha Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among u by us, even by me N Silvanus N Timotheus, was not yeah N no, but in him was yeah.
4 all tha promises of God in him r yeah, N in him Amen, 2 tha glory of God by us.
Now he which stablisheth us wit u in Christ, N has anointed us, is God;
Who has also sealed us, N given tha earnest of tha Spirit in our hearts.
Moreover I call God 4 a record upon my soul, dat 2 spare u I came not as yet 2 Corinth.
Not 4 dat we have dominion over ur faith, but r helpers of ur joy: 4 by faith y’all stand.

2.text: But I determined dis wit myself, dat I would not come again 2 u in heaviness.
4 if I make u sorry, who is he then dat makes me glad, but tha same which is made sorry by me?
N I wrote dis same 2 u, lest, when I came, I should have sorrow from ’em of whom I ought 2 rejoice; havin confidence in u all, dat my joy is tha joy of u all.
4 out of much affliction N anguish of heart I wrote 2 u wit many tears; not dat y’all should be grieved, but dat y’all might know tha love which I have more abundantly 2 u.
But if any have caused grief, he has not grieved me, but in part: dat I may not overcharge u all.
Sufficient 2 such a man is dis punishment, which was inflicted of many.
So dat contrariwise y’all ought rather 2 forgive him, N comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up wit overmuch sorrow.
So I beg u dat y’all would confirm ur love toward him.
4 2 dis end also did I write, dat I might know tha proof of u, whether y’all be obedient in all things.
2 whom y’all forgive any thing, I forgive also: 4 if I forgave any thing, 2 whom I forgave it, 4 ur sakes forgave I it in tha person of Christ;
Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: 4 we r not ignorant of his devices.
Furthermore, when I came 2 Troas 2 preach Christ’s gospel, N a door was opened 2 me of tha Lord,
I had no rest in my spirit, because I found not Titus my brother: but takin my leave of ’em, I went from thence in2 Macedonia.
Now thanks be 2 God, which always causes us 2 triumph in Christ, N makes manifest tha savour of his knowledge by us in every place.
4 we r 2 God a sweet savour of Christ, in ’em dat r saved, N in ’em dat perish:
2 tha one we r tha savour of death 2 death; N 2 tha other tha savour of life 2 life. N who is sufficient 4 dese things?
4 we r not as many, which corrupt tha word of God: but as of sincerity, but as of God, in tha sight of God speak we in Christ.

3.text: Do we begin again 2 commend ourselves? or need we, as some others, epistles of commendation 2 u, or letters of commendation from u?
y’all r our epistle written in our hearts, known N read of all men:

Forasmuch as y’all r manifestly declared 2 be tha epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not wit ink, but wit tha Spirit of tha livin God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of tha heart.
N such trust have we through Christ 2 God-ward:
Not dat we r sufficient of ourselves 2 think any thing as of ourselves; but our sufficiency is of God;
Who also has made us able ministers of tha new testament; not of tha letter, but of tha spirit: 4 tha letter kills, but tha spirit gives life.

But if tha ministration of death, written N engraven in stones, was glorious, so dat tha children of Israel could not stedfastly look tha face of Moses 4 tha glory of his countenance; which glory was 2 be done away:
How shall not tha ministration of tha spirit be rather glorious?
4 if tha ministration of condemnation be glory, much more does tha ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.
4 even dat which was made glorious had no glory in dis respect, by reason of tha glory dat excelleth.
4 if dat which is done away was glorious, much more dat which remains is glorious.
Seein then dat we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
N not as Moses, which put a vail over his face, dat tha children of Israel could not stedfastly look 2 tha end of dat which is abolished:
But their minds were blinded: 4 until dis day remains tha same vail untaken away in tha reading of tha old testament; which vail is done away in Christ.
But even 2 dis day, when Moses is read, tha vail is upon their heart.
Nevertheless when it shall turn 2 tha Lord, tha vail shall be taken away.
Now tha Lord is dat Spirit: N where tha Spirit of tha Lord is, there is liberty.
But we all, wit open face beholding as in a glass tha glory of tha Lord, r changed in2 tha same image from glory 2 glory, even as by tha Spirit of tha Lord.

4.text: Therefore seein we have dis ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;

But have renounced tha hidden things of dishonesty, not walkin in craftiness, nor handling tha word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of tha truth commending ourselves 2 every man’s conscience in tha sight of God.
But if our gospel be hid, it is hid 2 ’em dat r lost:
In whom tha god of dis world has blinded tha minds of ’em which believe not, lest tha light of tha glorious gospel of Christ, who is tha image of God, should shine 2 ’em.
4 we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus tha Lord; N ourselves ur servants 4 Jesus’ sake.
4 God, who commanded tha light 2 shine out of darkness, has shined in our hearts, 2 give tha light of tha knowledge of tha glory of God in tha face of Jesus Christ.
But we have dis treasure in earthen vessels, dat tha excellency of tha power may be of God, N not of us.
We r troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we r perplexed, but not in despair;
Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
Always bearin about in tha body tha dyin of tha Lord Jesus, dat tha life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
4 we which live r alway delivered 2 death 4 Jesus’ sake, dat tha life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
So then death works in us, but life in u.
We havin tha same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, N therefore have I spoken; we also believe, N therefore speak;
Knowin dat he which raised up tha Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, N shall present us wit u.
4 all things r 4 ur sakes, dat tha abundant grace might through tha thanksgiving of many redound 2 tha glory of God.
4 which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet tha inward man is renewed day by day.
4 our light affliction, which is but 4 a moment, works 4 us a far more exceeding N eternal weight of glory;
While we look not at tha things which r seen, but at tha things which r not seen: 4 tha things which r seen r temporal; but tha things which r not seen r eternal.

5.text: 4 we know dat if our earthly house of dis tabernacle were dissolved, we have a buildin of God, an house not made wit hands, eternal in tha heavenz.
4 in dis we groan, earnestly desiring 2 be clothed upon wit our house which is from heaven:
If so be dat bein clothed we shall not be found naked.
4 we dat r in dis tabernacle do groan, bein burdened: not 4 dat we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, dat mortality might be swallowed up of life.
Now he dat has wrought us 4 tha selfsame thing is God, who also has given 2 us tha earnest of tha Spirit.
Therefore we r always confident, knowin dat, whilst we r at home in tha body, we r absent from tha Lord:
(4 we walk by faith, not by sight:)
We r confident, I say, N willin rather 2 be absent from tha body, N 2 be present wit tha Lord.
So we labour, dat, whether present or absent, we may be accepted of him.
4 we must all appear before tha judgment seat of Christ; dat every one may receive tha things done in his body, according 2 dat he has done, whether it be good or bad.
Knowin therefore tha terror of tha Lord, we persuade men; but we r made manifest 2 God; N I trust also r made manifest in ur consciences.
4 we commend not ourselves again 2 u, but give u occasion 2 glory on our behalf, dat y’all may have somewhat 2 answer ’em which glory in appearance, N not in heart.
4 whether we be beside ourselves, it is 2 God: or whether we be sober, it is 4 ur cause.
4 tha love of Christ constraineth us; because we like dis judge, dat if one died 4 all, then were all dead:
N dat he died 4 all, dat dey which live should not from now on live 2 themselves, but 2 him which died 4 ’em, N rose again.
So from now on know we no man after tha flesh: yeah, though we have known Christ after tha flesh, yet now from now on know we him no more.
Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things r passed away; look, all things r become new.
N all things r of God, who has reconciled us 2 himself by Jesus Christ, N has given 2 us tha ministry of reconciliation;
2 wit, dat God was in Christ, reconciling tha world 2 himself, not imputing their trespasses 2 ’em; N has committed 2 us tha word of reconciliation.
Now then we r ambassadors 4 Christ, as though God did beg u by us: we pray u in Christ’s stead, be y’all reconciled 2 God.
4 he has made him 2 be sin 4 us, who knew no sin; dat we might be made tha righteousness of God in him.

6.text: We then, as workers together wit him, beg u also dat y’all receive not tha grace of God in vain.
(4 he says, I have heard u in a time accepted, N in tha day of salvation have I succoured u: look, now is tha accepted time; look, now is tha day of salvation.)
Givin no offence in any thing, dat tha ministry don’t be blamed:
But in all things approving ourselves as tha ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by tha Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
By tha word of truth, by tha power of God, by tha armour of righteousness on tha right hand N on tha left,
By honour N dishonour, by evil report N good report: as deceivers, N yet true;
As unknown, N yet well known; as dyin, N, look, we live; as chastened, N not killed;
As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicin; as poor, yet makin many rich; as havin nothing, N yet possessing all things.
O y’all Corinthians, our mouth is open 2 u, our heart is enlarged.
y’all r not straitened in us, but y’all r straitened in ur own bowels.
Now 4 a recompence in tha same, (I speak as 2 my children,) be y’all also enlarged.
Be y’all not unequally yoked together wit unbelievers: 4 what fellowship has righteousness wit unrighteousness? N what communion has light wit darkness?
N what concord has Christ wit Belial? or what part has he dat believes wit an infidel?
N what agreement has tha temple of God wit idols? 4 y’all r tha temple of tha livin God; as God has said, I will live in ’em, N walk in ’em; N I will be their God, N dey shall be my people.
So come out from among ’em, N be y’all separate, says tha Lord, N touch not tha unclean thing; N I will receive u,
N will be a Father 2 u, N y’all shall be my sons N daughters, says tha Lord Almighty.

7.text: Havin therefore dese promises, dearly beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of tha flesh N spirit, perfecting holiness in tha fear of God.
Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.
I speak not dis 2 condemn u: 4 I have said before, dat y’all r in our hearts 2 die N live wit u.
Great is my boldness of speech toward u, great is my glorying of u: I am filled wit comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
4, when we were come in2 Macedonia, our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; without were fightings, within were fears.
Nevertheless God, dat comforteth dose dat r cast down, comforted us by tha comin of Titus;
N not by his comin only, but by tha consolation wherewith he was comforted in u, when he told us ur earnest desire, ur mournin, ur fervent mind toward me; so dat I rejoiced tha more.
4 though I made u sorry wit a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: 4 I perceive dat tha same epistle has made u sorry, though it were but 4 a season.
Now I rejoice, not dat y’all were made sorry, but dat y’all sorrowed 2 repentance: 4 y’all were made sorry after a godly manner, dat y’all might receive damage by us in nothing.
4 godly sorrow works repentance 2 salvation not 2 be repented of: but tha sorrow of tha world works death.

4 look dis selfsame thing, dat y’all sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in u, yeah, what clearing of y’all, yeah, what indignation, yeah, what fear, yeah, what vehement desire, yeah, what zeal, yeah, what revenge! In all things y’all have approved y’all 2 be clear in dis matter.
So, though I wrote 2 u, I did it not 4 his cause dat had done tha wrong, nor 4 his cause dat suffered wrong, but dat our care 4 u in tha sight of God might appear 2 u.
Therefore we were comforted in ur comfort: yeah, N exceedingly tha more joyed we 4 tha joy of Titus, because his spirit was refreshed by u all.
4 if I have boasted any thing 2 him of u, I am not ashamed; but as we spoke all things 2 u in truth, even so our boastin, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.
N his inward affection is more abundant toward u, whilst he remembereth tha obedience of u all, how wit fear N tremblin y’all received him.
I rejoice therefore dat I have confidence in u in all things.

8.text: Moreover, brothers, we do u 2 wit of tha grace of God bestowed on tha churches of Macedonia;
How dat in a great trial of affliction tha abundance of their joy N their deep poverty abounded 2 tha riches of their liberality.
4 2 their power, I bear record, yeah, N beyond their power dey were willin of themselves;
Prayin us wit much intreaty dat we would receive tha gift, N take upon us tha fellowship of tha ministering 2 tha saints.
N dis dey did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves 2 tha Lord, N 2 us by tha will of God.
Insomuch dat we desired Titus, dat as he had begun, so he would also finish in u tha same grace also.
Therefore, as y’all abound in every thing, in faith, N utterance, N knowledge, N in all diligence, N in ur love 2 us, see dat y’all abound in dis grace also.
I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of tha forwardness of others, N 2 prove tha sincerity of ur love.
4 y’all know tha grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, dat, though he was rich, yet 4 ur sakes he became poor, dat y’all through his poverty might be rich.
N in dis I give my advice: 4 dis is expedient 4 u, who have begun before, not only 2 do, but also 2 be forward a year ago.
Now therefore perform tha doin of it; dat as there was a readiness 2 will, so there may be a performance also out of dat which y’all have.
4 if there be first a willin mind, it is accepted according 2 dat a man has, N not according 2 dat he has not.
4 I mean not dat other men be eased, N y’all burdened:
But by an equality, dat now at dis time ur abundance may be a supply 4 their want, dat their abundance also may be a supply 4 ur want: dat there may be equality:
As it is written, He dat had gathered much had nothing over; N he dat had gathered little had no lack.
But thanks be 2 God, which put tha same earnest care in2 tha heart of Titus 4 u.
4 indeed he accepted tha exhortation; but bein more forward, of his own accord he went 2 u.
N we have sent wit him tha brother, whose praise is in tha gospel throughout all tha churches;
N not dat only, but who was also chosen of tha churches 2 travel wit us wit dis grace, which is administered by us 2 tha glory of tha same Lord, N declaration of ur ready mind:
Avoiding dis, dat no man should blame us in dis abundance which is administered by us:
Providing 4 honest things, not only in tha sight of tha Lord, but also in tha sight of men.
N we have sent wit ’em our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon tha great confidence which I have in u.
Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner N fellowhelper concerning u: or our brothers be enquired of, dey r tha messengers of tha churches, N tha glory of Christ.
So show y’all 2 ’em, N before tha churches, tha proof of ur love, N of our boastin on ur behalf.

9.text: 4 as touching tha ministering 2 tha saints, it is superfluous 4 me 2 write 2 u:
4 I know tha forwardness of ur mind, 4 which I boast of u 2 ’em of Macedonia, dat Achaia was ready a year ago; N ur zeal has provoked very many.
Yet have I sent tha brothers, lest our boastin of u should be in vain in dis behalf; dat, as I said, y’all may be ready:
Lest maybe if dey of Macedonia come wit me, N find u unprepared, we (dat we say not, y’all) should be ashamed in dis same confident boastin.

Therefore I thought it necessary 2 exhort tha brothers, dat dey would go before 2 u, N make up beforehand ur bounty, whereof y’all had notice before, dat tha same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, N not as of covetousness.
But dis I say, He which sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly; N he which sows bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: 4 God loves a cheerful giver.
N God is able 2 make all grace abound toward u; dat y’all, always havin all sufficiency in all things, may abound 2 every good work:
(As it is written, He has dispersed abroad; he has given 2 tha poor: his righteousness remains 4 ever.
Now he dat ministereth seed 2 tha sower both minister bread 4 ur food, N multiply ur seed sown, N increase tha fruits of ur righteousness;)
Bein enriched in every thing 2 all bountifulness, which causes through us thanksgiving 2 God.
4 tha administration of dis service not only supplieth tha want of tha saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings 2 God;
Whiles by tha experiment of dis ministration dey glorify God 4 ur professed subjection 2 tha gospel of Christ, N 4 ur liberal distribution 2 ’em, N 2 all men;
N by their prayer 4 u, which long after u 4 tha exceeding grace of God in u.
Thanks be 2 God 4 his unspeakable gift.

10.text: Now I Paul myself beg u by tha meekness N gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among u, but bein absent am bold toward u:
But I beg u, dat I may not be bold when I am present wit dat confidence, wherewith I think 2 be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according 2 tha flesh.
4 though we walk in tha flesh, we do not war after tha flesh:
(4 tha weapons of our warfare r not carnal, but mighty through God 2 tha pulling down of strong holds;)
Castin down imaginations, N every high thing dat exalts itself against tha knowledge of God, N bringin in2 captivity every thought 2 tha obedience of Christ;
N havin in a readiness 2 revenge all disobedience, when ur obedience is fulfilled.
Do y’all look on things after tha outward appearance? If any man trust 2 himself dat he is Christ’s, let him of himself think dis again, dat, as he is Christ’s, even so r we Christ’s.
4 though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which tha Lord has given us 4 edification, N not 4 ur destruction, I should not be ashamed:
Dat I may not seem as if I would terrify u by letters.
4 his letters, say dey, r weighty N powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, N his speech contemptible.
Let such an one think dis, dat, such as we r in word by letters when we r absent, such will we be also in deed when we r present.
4 we dare not make ourselves of tha number, or compare ourselves wit some dat commend themselves: but dey measuring themselves by themselves, N comparing themselves among themselves, r not wise.
But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according 2 tha measure of tha rule which God has distributed 2 us, a measure 2 reach even 2 u.
4 we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not 2 u: 4 we r come as far as 2 u also in preachin tha gospel of Christ:
Not boastin of things without our measure, dat is, of other men’s labours; but havin hope, when ur faith is increased, dat we shall be enlarged by u according 2 our rule abundantly,
2 preach tha gospel in tha regions beyond u, N not 2 boast in another man’s line of things made ready 2 our hand.
But he dat glorieth, let him glory in tha Lord.
4 not he dat commendeth himself is approved, but whom tha Lord commendeth.

11.text: Would 2 God y’all could bear wit me a little in my folly: N indeed bear wit me.
4 I am jealous over u wit godly jealousy: 4 I have espoused u 2 one husband, dat I may present u as a chaste virgin 2 Christ.
But I fear, lest by any means, as tha serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so ur minds should be corrupted from tha simplicity dat is in Christ.

4 if he dat comes preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if y’all receive another spirit, which y’all have not received, or another gospel, which y’all have not accepted, y’all might well bear wit him.
4 I suppose I was not a whit behind tha very chiefest apostles.
But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among u in all things.
Have I committed an offence in abasing myself dat y’all might be exalted, because I have preached 2 u tha gospel of God freely?
I robbed other churches, takin wages of ’em, 2 do u service.

N when I was present wit u, N wanted, I was chargeable 2 no man: 4 dat which was lacking 2 me tha brothers which came from Macedonia supplied: N in all things I have kept myself from bein burdensome 2 u, N so will I keep myself.
As tha truth of Christ is in me, no man shall stop me of dis boastin in tha regions of Achaia.
So? because I love u not? God knows.
But what I do, dat I will do, dat I may cut off occasion from ’em which desire occasion; dat in which dey glory, dey may be found even as we.
4 such r false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves in2 tha apostles of Christ.
N no marvel; 4 Satan himself is transformed in2 an angel of light.
Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as tha ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according 2 their works.
I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, dat I may boast myself a little.
Dat which I speak, I speak it not after tha Lord, but as it were foolishly, in dis confidence of boastin.
Seein dat many glory after tha flesh, I will glory also.
4 y’all suffer fools gladly, seein y’all y’all r wise.
4 y’all suffer, if a man bring u in2 bondage, if a man devour u, if a man take of u, if a man exalt himself, if a man strike u on tha face.
I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. but whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
R dey Hebrews? so am I. r dey Israelites? so am I. r dey tha seed of Abraham? so am I.
R dey ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
Of tha Jews five times received I forty stripes save one.
Thrice was I beaten wit rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night N a day I have been in tha deep;

In journeyings often, in perils of waterz, in perils of robbers, in perils by my own countrymen, in perils by tha heathen, in perils in tha city, in perils in tha wilderness, in perils in tha sea, in perils among false brothers;
In weariness N painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger N thirst, in fastings often, in cold N nakedness.
Beside dose things dat r without, dat which comes upon me daily, tha care of all tha churches.
Who is weak, N I am not weak? who is offended, N I burn not?
If I must needs glory, I will glory of tha things which concern mine infirmities.
Tha God N Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which is blessed 4 evermore, knows dat I lie not.
In Damascus tha governor under Aretas tha king kept tha city of tha Damascenes wit a garrison, desirous 2 apprehend me:
N through a window in a basket was I let down by tha wall, N escaped his hands.

12.text: It is not expedient 4 me doubtless 2 glory. I will come 2 visions N revelations of tha Lord.
I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in tha body, I cannot tell; or whether out of tha body, I cannot tell: God knows;) such an one caught up 2 tha third heaven.
N I knew such a man, (whether in tha body, or out of tha body, I cannot tell: God knows;)
How dat he was caught up in2 paradise, N heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful 4 a man 2 utter.
Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.
4 though I would desire 2 glory, I shall not be a fool; 4 I will say tha truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above dat which he sees me 2 be, or dat he hears of me.

N lest I should be exalted above measure through tha abundance of tha revelations, there was given 2 me a thorn in tha flesh, tha messenger of Satan 2 buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
4 dis thing I besought tha Lord thrice, dat it might depart from me.
N he said 2 me, My grace is sufficient 4 u: 4 my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, dat tha power of Christ may rest upon me.
Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses 4 Christ’s sake: 4 when I am weak, then am I strong.
I am become a fool in glorying; y’all have compelled me: 4 I ought 2 have been commended of u: 4 in nothing am I behind tha very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
Truly tha signs of an apostle were wrought among u in all patience, in signs, N wonders, N mighty deeds.
4 what is it in which y’all were inferior 2 other churches, except it be dat I myself was not burdensome 2 u? forgive me dis wrong.
Look, tha third time I am ready 2 come 2 u; N I will not be burdensome 2 u: 4 I seek not urz, but u: 4 tha children ought not 2 lay up 4 tha parents, but tha parents 4 tha children.
N I will very gladly spend N be spent 4 u; though tha more abundantly I love u, tha less I be loved.
But be it so, I did not burden u: nevertheless, bein crafty, I caught u wit guile.
Did I make a gain of u by any of ’em whom I sent 2 u?
I desired Titus, N wit him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of u? walked we not in tha same spirit? walked we not in tha same steps?
Again, think y’all dat we excuse ourselves 2 u? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, 4 ur edifying.

4 I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find u such as I would, N dat I shall be found 2 u such as y’all would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

N lest, when I come again, my God will humble me among u, N dat I shall bewail many which have sinned already, N have not repented of tha uncleanness N fornication N lasciviousness which dey have committed.

13.text: Dis is tha third time I am comin 2 u. In tha mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
I told u before, N foretell u, as if I were present, tha second time; N bein absent now I write 2 ’em which before now have sinned, N 2 all other, dat, if I come again, I will not spare:
Since y’all seek a proof of Christ speakin in me, which 2 u-ward is not weak, but is mighty in u.
4 though he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives by tha power of God. 4 we also r weak in him, but we shall live wit him by tha power of God toward u.
Examine y’all, whether y’all be in tha faith; prove ur own selves. Know y’all not ur own selves, how dat Jesus Christ is in u, except y’all be reprobates?
But I trust dat y’all shall know dat we r not reprobates.
Now I pray 2 God dat y’all do no evil; not dat we should appear approved, but dat y’all should do dat which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
4 we can do nothing against tha truth, but 4 tha truth.
4 we r glad, when we r weak, N y’all r strong: N dis also we wish, even ur perfection.
Therefore I write dese things bein absent, lest bein present I should use sharpness, according 2 tha power which tha Lord has given me 2 edification, N not 2 destruction.
Finally, brothers, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; N tha God of love N peace shall be wit u.
Greet one another wit an holy kiss.
Tha grace of tha Lord Jesus Christ, N tha love of God, N tha communion of tha Holy Ghost, be wit u all. Amen.
